ZombieChess.Name: Zombie Chess
ZombieChess.Description: Turns captured pieces into your own.

Poof.Name: POOF!
Poof.Description: A random piece, is removed every x moves.

MoveMultiplier.Name: Multi-Tap
MoveMultiplier.Description: Each Player gets x moves in a row unless opponent is checked.

Wormholes.Name: Quantum Chess
Wormholes.Description: Creates x, connected portals on random empty squares. You'll have to figure out which are connected on your own.

TimeLimit.Name: Under The Gun
TimeLimit.Description: Each Player gets a Timer that's active while it's his turn. Once a Player's time runs out, they will lose.

KingPromotion.Name: The King's Journey
KingPromotion.Description: When a Player's King reaches a Promotion Rank, the player wins. Normal Chess rules still apply - so be careful of Checkmate!
